_ghiChu: NGUON DUY NHAT cua mau do hiem (de xuat 4, chu game duyet 19/10/2026; thiet_ke_can_bang 4.3): vat pham, danh hieu, phu kien ngoai hinh, bac trang bi. Sua file nay roi chay python3 tools/cauhinh/sinh_cau_hinh.py (sinh luon cung danh muc cau hinh) -> server/src/com/htbb/pokemon/DoHiemSinh.java, client_jar/src/game/pokemon/DoHiemSinh.java, web/shared/utils/doHiem.gen.ts, sql/them_do_hiem.sql, khoi mau trong tools/pokemon/SinhPhuKien.java. mau = chu / vien tren nen sang (bang, the, web; tuong phan >= 4,5 tren trang, >= 3 tren nen giay da NRO), nhat = nen nhat cung tong (vien danh hieu, o chon), sang = chu tren nen toi / the gioi (nhan tren dau, the toi), phuKien = 5 tong bang mau phu kien ve tren than (vien, toi, goc, sang, diem). vienDong = vien chay / lap lanh (Huyen thoai).
_ghiChuMauVatPham: Item.colorName (data_item.colortype) -> bac. Theo GIA TRI THAT cua du lieu hien tai (thiet_ke_can_bang muc 7: Trang -> Thuong, Xanh 110% (ma 3) -> Hiem, Do 120% (ma 2) -> Quy, Hoan my 130% (ma 1) -> Su thi; 4 tim = do thoi trang su kien -> Su thi; 5 vang = trang tri; 6 = Huyen thoai moi, 7 = Hiem moi). Khi chay chuyen doi ma 0.9.7 (3 -> 7, 2 -> 3, 1 -> 4) chi sua bang nay. Ma khong co trong bang -> Thuong.
_ghiChuDanhHieu: data_danh_hieu.do_hiem (0 Thuong, 1 Hiem, 2 Su thi, 3 Huyen thoai) -> bac chung.
_ghiChuBacTrangBi: 11 bac trang bi theo cap (NgoaiHinh.TEN_BAC, vong sang duoi chan / vien Pokemon). theoHiem = lay mau goc phu kien cua bac hiem cung ten / y nghia (mot nguon). Bac 10 Toi thuong doi mau cau vong (client).
